description: Remove Blur pass: Topaz Video AI Iris run at 1:1 (no resolution change) between Remove Noise/Grain and Remove Halo, to recover detail in soft/blurry sources. Originally the 1st pass of a captured Iris -> Artemis GUI stack (1st enhancement = Iris, Input condition = Medium quality, Advanced tuning = Automatic, Recover detail = 100); split out so blurry video without haloing can be cleaned up without the dehalo model. Parameters match the real ffmpeg.exe command line Topaz Video AI ran, not a literal reading of the GUI sliders.
_note_recover_detail: Despite 'Recover detail = 100' being set in the GUI, the captured command line shows details=0 -- Advanced tuning = Automatic instead enables estimate=8 (auto frame-sampled parameter analysis), which is what actually drives detail recovery, not the manual 'details' AVOption.
purpose: Recovers detail and sharpness in soft or blurry sources without changing resolution.

passes._note_variants: Picked by the stage's input height: first entry whose min_height <= height wins. Shortnames confirmed against the installed model JSONs (iris-2 gui name 'Iris - Medium Quality', iris-3 'Iris - Low Quality'); both expose the same parameters, so the captured Medium-quality params are reused for Low quality.

encoder._note: Mezzanine-quality encode (cq=14), same as deinterlace.py/dehalo -- this output feeds later stages, not the end user.
